description: Bug backlog. Process: docs/issues.md. Sibling of feature_list.json; the leader appends new reports as 'reported'.

rules.human_only_transitions: pending -> approved | wontfix, and -> done. Agents never make these.

fields.name: kebab-case slug; folder is issues/<name>/
fields.title: one line
fields.severity: low | medium | high | critical, as reported (triager may amend in analysis.md)
fields.covers: FR-*/NFR-* ids the defect violates; filled by issue_triager
fields.classification: defect | spec_gap | arch_pending | not_a_defect; filled by issue_triager

issues.name: debug-requires-aws-credentials
issues.title: Debug mode still requires generic AWS credentials despite Bedrock URL and API key
issues.report: Debug still requires generic AWS credentials even though we have defined url and api key for bedrock.

issues.name: blank-screen-after-login
issues.title: Screen goes blank after login until manual refresh (user without forced password change)
issues.report: When I log in with a user that does not need to change password, the screen turns blank until I manually refresh the page.

issues.name: servings-and-time-inputs-not-numeric
issues.title: Comensales and tiempo estimado are text inputs, without steppers or units
issues.report: Comensales and tiempo estimado are string inputs, they don't have the "1 up/1 down" button for convenience. Also they don't mention units. They should say tiempo estimado is measured in minutes.

issues.name: empty-field-error-messages
issues.title: Empty required fields show a wrong error (e.g. empty Unidad says "La unidad indicada no está permitida.")
issues.report: When no unidad is selected in the escribir desde cero menú for creating a recipe, the message is "La unidad indicada no está permitida." rather than "El campo Unidad no puede estar vacío.". This should apply for similar messages in other fields.

issues.name: new-recipe-not-shown-in-library
issues.title: A newly added recipe does not appear in the library until manual refresh
issues.report: When a recipe has been added, it does not appear in the library right ahead. I have to manually refresh the page.

issues.name: negative-ingredient-quantity
issues.title: Ingredient quantity (Unidad) accepts negative values
issues.report: Unidad in ingredientes should not be able to have a negative value.

issues.name: recipe-saved-without-required-sections
issues.title: Recipes can be saved without ingredientes, utensilios or elaboración
issues.report: Users should not be able to save recipes without ingredientes, utensilios or elaboración.

issues.name: close-button-style
issues.title: "Cerrar" button in recipe creation menu does not follow the app's button format
issues.report: Button "Cerrar" in the recipe creation menu doesn't follow the app format.

issues.name: ui-not-reflecting-mutations
issues.title: Removing a library item does not update the UI until refresh; audit all operations
issues.report: Removing an item from the library doesn't remove it from the UI right away, I have to manually refresh the page. In general, review that all operations have an effect in the UI, not only in the DB.
